Archiving in the web app, a "welcome back" prompt after sleep or a logout, and the web app one click from the menu bar or tray.

## Download

- **macOS 13 or newer** (Apple Silicon and Intel): [TasksBar.zip](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/releases/download/v2.1.0/TasksBar.zip)
- **Windows** (64-bit): [TasksTray.exe](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/releases/download/v2.1.0/TasksTray.exe)

The apps aren't signed yet, so your system will warn you the first time:

- **macOS:** unzip, move `TasksBar.app` to Applications (replacing the old one), then run this once:
  ```sh
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/TasksBar.app
  ```
- **Windows:** choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## What's new

- **Archive from the web app:** any todo that isn't running gets an **Archive** button, which moves it and its subtasks to `TODO.archive.md`. The archive icon in the status bar lists everything archived, and **Restore** brings a todo back with its subtasks.
- **Done todos leave after a week:** finished top-level todos now move to the archive 7 days after completion (it was 14), checked every hour instead of only when something changes. Each project can set its own delay in **Edit project**. Projects created before this release keep their current setting (14 days) until you change it there.
- **Welcome back:** when the computer sleeps, shuts down or logs out, the apps still pause the running task, and now they also ask whether to resume it when you're back, instead of leaving the timer off without saying so.
- **The web app by the icon:** **Open web app** shows it in a small window next to the menu-bar icon (on Windows, a click on the tray icon does it too). It uses the apps' login, so there's no separate browser login. **Open in browser** is still in the menu.
- **New look for the check-in:** the "how far along?" window has no title bar anymore and uses the web app's rounded buttons. On Windows it gets a close button in the corner.

## Upgrading

- **Server:** deploy the new image as described in [DEPLOY.md](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/blob/v2.1.0/DEPLOY.md). The web window in the apps needs nothing new on the proxy: it uses the same login as the apps.
- **Command line tool:** update it from a copy of this repository:
  ```sh
  git pull && npm ci && npm run cli:install
  ```
  `npm ci` needs npm 11.6 or newer. With an older npm, update it with `npm install -g npm@latest`, or use `npm install` instead.
- **Windows:** the web window uses Microsoft Edge WebView2, which comes with Windows 10 and 11. If it's missing, the app opens the browser instead.
